blocks.text: The CEO of the Recording Academy in a statement confirmed that the Grammy Awards’ Asian pop category will debut in 2027 as planned. “Over the past several weeks the Academy has been conducting listening sessions and have been in dialogue with leaders of the Asian music community. The journey has been rewarding and inspiring,” Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. said in a statement obtained by Variety. “Our organization is at its best when we engage deeply with music people and go the extra mile to understand their lived experiences.” “In this case, we heard candid feedback from people in our […]...
